summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved low-risk security cleanup plan. PostgreSQL scheduler scoring now uses a SQLAlchemy make_interval expression with regression coverage against raw INTERVAL string interpolation; selected workspace create/idempotency/conflict error payloads preserve stable codes and public external_id/idempotency guidance without serialized task_external_id or related internal column-style fields; doctor and support-bundle tests prove configured API tokens and database credentials are redacted from emitted diagnostics. Existing validation summaries record passing focused pytest, ruff, mypy, MCP parity, and targeted static searches after Iteration 1.
